AgentCore harness export — cached 2026-10-07
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/harness-export.html
CLI: agentcore export harness --arn <arn> | --name <name>
  [--target-agent-name <name>] [--build CodeZip|Container] [--json]
Default target agent name: <harnessName>Agent. Default build: CodeZip.
Framework: Strands only (Claude Agents SDK "coming soon"). Language: Python only.
Carried into generated agent (LITERAL LIST):
  - Model provider and config (Bedrock, OpenAI, Gemini - including model ID and API key references)
  - Tools - Remote MCP tools, Gateways, inline function tools, AgentCore Browser,
    AgentCore Code Interpreter, built-in `shell` and `file_operations` tools
  - Memory
  - Execution limits
  - Conversation truncation
  - Skills (Path, S3, Git)
  - Filesystem mounts (session storage, EFS, S3) for VPC harnesses
  - Authorizer configuration
Post-export: EXPORT_NOTES.md written with manual follow-up items. Then `agentcore deploy`.
Deployment options: AgentCore Runtime (managed) OR self-hosted anywhere Python 3.12+ —
  Lambda, ECS/Fargate, EC2, Kubernetes clusters, on-premise servers, any containerized env.
